title: Mien kernel capability manifest
description: Machine-readable companion to docs/specs/browser-runtime/SPEC.md and docs/specs/fingerprint-engine/SPEC.md. The SPECs remain normative.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the published release asset (the downloaded DMG/TAR.XZ/ZIP), never the extracted executable digest. Install records carry asset_sha256 and binary_sha256 separately; runtime verification uses binary_sha256.

sandbox_kind.description: Sandbox mechanism this artifact depends on: namespace on Linux (with a mandatory seccomp profile), seatbelt on macOS, win32-restricted-token on Windows (restricted token, job object and integrity levels; not AppContainer), none when the artifact cannot sandbox. Declaring a kind does not replace verifying the effective sandbox before serving traffic.

values.description: Allowed values for flags without platform-specific restrictions. Reject values outside this set; never drop them silently.

per_platform_values.description: Allowed values per persona platform (windows, macos, linux), e.g. realistic CPU core counts. When present it is authoritative for that flag and supersedes values; consumers must not widen the set by merging the two sources.
